_meta.title: Galatians — key verses per chapter (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Several curated key verses from each of the 6 chapters of Galatians. Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 48 Galatians); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: several key verses per chapter (~1-4, scaled to chapter substance)
_meta.keying: book + chapter + citation; multiple records per chapter
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: KJV New Testament renders the divine name as 'Lord'/'God' (no tetragrammaton); text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
verses.plain: Am I now trying to win people's approval, or God's? If I were still trying to please people, I wouldn't be a servant of Christ.

verses.text: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
verses.plain: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live — but Christ lives in me. The life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.

verses.text: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.plain: For you are all children of God through faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.text: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.plain: There is no Jew or Greek, slave or free, male or female — for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

verses.text: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
verses.plain: And because you are his children, God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, crying out, 'Abba, Father.'

verses.text: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
verses.plain: So you are no longer a slave, but a child; and since you are his child, God has made you an heir.

verses.text: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
verses.plain: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. So stand firm, and don't let yourselves be burdened again by a yoke of slavery.

verses.text: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
verses.plain: You were called to freedom, brothers and sisters — only don't use your freedom to indulge the flesh; rather, serve one another in love.

verses.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
verses.plain: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

verses.text: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
verses.plain: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

verses.text: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
verses.plain: Carry each other's burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.

verses.text: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
verses.plain: Don't be deceived: God is not mocked. A person reaps whatever they sow.

verses.text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
verses.plain: Let us not grow weary in doing good, for at the right time we will reap a harvest if we don't give up.
